apps.title: Ape Rumble
apps.summary:
The world has fallen. Mutants roam the ruins. Only the strongest alliances will survive.
Ape World is a strategy war game built for commanders who play to win. Recruit and upgrade your ape warriors, build a fortress that can withstand any siege, and lead your alliance into all-out war against rival factions across a massive world map.
War is everything here. Launch coordinated strikes on enemy bases, raid supply lines, ambush incoming attacks, and crush anyone who threatens your territory. Every battle is a test of strategy — the right timing, the right formation, the right alliance can flip the outcome in seconds.
Alliances are how you dominate. Solo players survive. Alliance players conquer. Team up with commanders from around the world, coordinate large-scale assaults, defend each other's bases, and climb the alliance rankings together. The biggest battles in Ape World are won or lost before the first soldier moves.
Expand your territory through force. The world map is a living warzone — capture strategic resource points, push your borders outward, and hold your ground against the players who want what you've built.
Fight the mutant threat. Scattered across the world are powerful mutant bosses that drop rare rewards. Hunt them down with your alliance and grow stronger together.
Build, upgrade, and optimize your base. Unlock powerful tech, train specialized ape units, and customize your war machine to match your playstyle — whether you're a frontline attacker or a fortress defender.
Real-time global warfare. Millions of commanders. One world map. Zero mercy.
Form your alliance. Command your apes. Take the world !

apps.title: Bus Jam: Traffic Trouble
apps.summary:
Can you clear the bus stop before traffic grinds to a halt?

Welcome to Bus Jam: Traffic Trouble, a colorful puzzle game where every move matters. Guide passengers through crowded pathways, match them with the correct buses, and keep the line moving without creating a traffic disaster.

What starts as a simple boarding task quickly turns into a satisfying puzzle challenge. Riders block one another, new colors appear, hidden passengers are revealed, and every level requires careful planning to avoid getting stuck.

How to Play
Tap passengers to send them toward the boarding area.
Match riders with buses of the correct color.
Fill each bus and dispatch it to free up space.
Plan ahead to prevent blocked paths and traffic jams.
Complete increasingly challenging levels filled with new obstacles.
Features

🚌 Easy-to-learn passenger sorting gameplay

🎯 Hundreds of handcrafted puzzle challenges

🔍 Hidden passengers and surprise level mechanics

🧩 Strategic decisions that reward smart planning

⚡ Helpful boosters when a level gets crowded

🎨 Unlock new themes and bus stop designs

🌟 Bright visuals and smooth animations

Whether you're looking for a quick brain teaser or a longer puzzle session, Bus Jam: Traffic Trouble offers a relaxing yet rewarding experience packed with satisfying passenger-sorting puzzles.

apps.title: Nomad Color By Number Games
apps.summary:
Nomad Color By Number Games
“I travel not to go anywhere, but to go. … The great affair is to move.”
— Robert Louis Stevenson, Travels with a Donkey in the Cévennes (1879)
Feeling trapped by schedules, notifications, and the same familiar routine?
Step into Nomad Color By Number Games and explore open grasslands, endless deserts, snowy mountains, and quiet frozen lands. Follow the numbers, tap to color, and find a sense of freedom far beyond the noise of everyday life.
Nomadic life is not aimless wandering. It follows the seasons, water, and grazing lands along familiar migration routes. Inspired by this ancient rhythm of life, Nomad Color is a relaxing paint by number game and adult coloring book filled with magnificent landscapes, traditional art, and stories of movement.
Explore the Nomadic World 🐎
- Grassland Seasons — yurts, horseback herding, sheep, family gatherings, and campfires beneath the stars
- Desert Routes — camel caravans, an oasis camp, traditional tents, and moonlit dunes
- Mountain Life — yaks, snowy peaks, seasonal camps, and lively highland markets
- Frozen Lands — reindeer, sleds, winter shelters, and life beneath the northern lights
- Migration Journeys — pack animals, family caravans, seasonal trails, and nighttime camps
- Myths and Heritage — guardian animal figures, symbolic patterns, traditional celebrations, and nomadic legends
This is more than an animal coloring book. Every picture connects nature, daily life, and migration into a complete story. From a young girl learning to ride to a caravan crossing the desert, each scene brings nomadic art and culture to life.
Easy and Relaxing Color by Number 🎨
No drawing or painting experience is needed. Every picture is a satisfying art puzzle guided by numbers.
- Select a numbered color
- Tap the matching areas
- Zoom in to complete small details
- Use hints to find unfinished spaces
- Save your progress and continue anytime
- You are free to color at your own pace
Simple controls and pressure-free gameplay help you slow down, focus, and settle into a peaceful, zen-like rhythm.
Let the seasons guide the route and let color carry you forward.
Download Nomad Color By Number Games today. The great affair is to move—one color at a time.

apps.title: Bible Trivia Journey
apps.summary:
How well do you really know the Bible?

Bible Trivia Journey turns Scripture into a daily habit. Thousands of questions across the Old and New Testaments, classic biblical art to identify, and a journey through the Holy Land that grows with you.

Why Play Bible Trivia Journey?

- Learn as you play - Questions span both Testaments, from Genesis to Revelation. The ones you miss are the ones that send you back to the Word.
- Picture rounds - Identify famous Bible scenes in classic engravings by Gustave Dore. No other Bible trivia game has them.
- 20 curated categories - Life of Jesus, Parables, Miracles, Women of the Bible, Kings and Prophets, Psalms and Proverbs, Revelation and more.
- Play anywhere - Full single-player offline play. No internet needed.
- Your language - Available in 48 languages.

How It Works

Each level gives you a set of trivia questions with four multiple-choice answers. Answer correctly to clear the level and move further along your journey. Miss one and you lose a heart; run out and you can wait for them to refill or use a hint to keep going. Levels mix in picture rounds, word-fill puzzles and bonus rounds, so it never settles into the same rhythm.

Features

- 5,000+ Bible questions across 20 categories
- Picture rounds featuring classic biblical art
- Word-fill puzzles and bonus round variety
- Daily challenges to build a streak
- Leagues - climb the ranks against players around the world
- Collect vistas as you journey through the Holy Land
- Single player, multiple-choice, play offline anytime

Whether you have been studying for years or are opening the Bible for the first time, Bible Trivia Journey meets you where you are.

Download Bible Trivia Journey and start your journey through Scripture today.

apps.title: Astro Merge
apps.summary:
Launch into a colourful cosmic merging challenge in Astro Merge.

Aim and release planets into the gravity field, then bring matching planets together to create larger worlds. Each successful merge opens more space, increases your score, and brings you closer to forming the biggest planets in the universe.

Plan each launch carefully as the play area fills. Use collisions and gravity to guide planets into position, create consecutive matches, and build up powerful combos. The longer you keep your universe under control, the higher your score can climb.

Features

• Launch planets into a dynamic gravity field
• Match identical planets to create larger worlds
• Plan around collisions, movement, and limited space
• Chain merges together to build your combo
• Discover colourful planets with unique designs
• Challenge yourself to achieve a new high score
• Enjoy simple controls and satisfying merge gameplay

How large can your universe become? Take aim, combine the planets, and reach for a new record in Astro Merge.

• Shuffle – Select a plank and shuffle the color cubes inside. Use it to reset a tricky arrangement and open up new matching possibilities.

• Extra – Add 2 more capacity slots when you need more room. It gives you valuable breathing space when the loop gets tight and every open spot matters.

Just pure color sort gameplay that clears your mind while you clear the board. If you love sorting games with unique conveyor mechanics and cozy puzzle vibes, this is your perfect match.

🌀 Sorting in Motion

This is more than a simple color sort. The loop keeps everything moving, so timing, order, and space management matter just as much as matching the right colors.

🏆 One Conveyor Loop, One Goal

In Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort, every move is about keeping the conveyor flowing, matching colors efficiently, and making smart use of limited space.

• Tap to send cubes onto the conveyor and set the loop in motion.
• As cubes travel around the belt, they wait for the right crate to open up.
• Gather four cubes of the same color in one crate to combine them into a complete piece.

Keep the Loop Clear

• Watch the conveyor capacity carefully, because only a limited number of cube groups can stay on the loop at once.
• If the conveyor fills up and no useful moves remain, the round comes to an end.
• Every open slot can change your next move, so keeping space available is part of the puzzle itself.

Cities lie in ruins, zombies roam the wasteland, and survival is more challenging than ever. Desperate survivors are searching for food, shelter, and hope—and your refuge may be their last chance.

apps.title: Royal Arrow: Merge & Match
apps.summary:
This casual puzzle game focuses on arrow-matching and merging mechanics. Designed with straightforward rules, it offers a relaxing gameplay experience through simple touch controls.
How to Play
Each level features a board filled with arrows pointing in various directions. By tapping and swiping the screen, you direct the paths of these arrows to match and eliminate them. Planning your moves carefully allows you to bypass obstacles, trigger chain reactions, and efficiently clear the board to advance to the next stage.

Game Features

Strategic Level Design: As you progress, the puzzle layouts become increasingly challenging. Different arrow combinations and board mechanics will require spatial thinking and observation to solve.
Offline Play: The game does not require an internet connection. You can play entirely offline, allowing you to enjoy a puzzle session wherever you are.
Casual Experience: With clean visual designs and a laid-back pace, the game is accessible to players of all ages looking for a straightforward puzzle experience during their spare time.
Royal Arrow: Merge & Match is an original puzzle game and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to any other brand or company.

apps.title: Toca Boca Jr Kitchen NETFLIX
apps.summary:
NETFLIX MEMBERSHIP REQUIRED. AD-FREE, UNLIMITED ACCESS FOR NETFLIX MEMBERS.

Create weird and wonderful recipes for guests in this open-ended cooking game for kids. Spaghetti smoothie? Deep-fried watermelon? Go ahead, try it!

"Toca Boca Jr Kitchen" invites all young chefs to get messy and start playing. With three guests to cook for, a kitchen full of different tools to use and countless food combinations to test out, the possibilities are infinite.

GET CREATIVE IN THE KITCHEN
Who said meals have to look good — or taste good? In "Toca Boca Jr Kitchen," you can cook however you want! Boil a salad, juice a shrimp or fry up a pineapple. Come up with your very own recipes and treat your guests to something special.

GO AHEAD, MAKE A MESS
With five different kitchen tools to choose from, you can explore all kinds of food experiments. Will you chop and sauté, or just load everything into the juicer? Prep your favorite ingredients, get messy and finish off with a pinch of something unexpected.

WATCH THEIR REACTIONS
Time to let your guest have a bite! Is it a winner? Discover your guests' preferences by seeing how they react. Oven-baked fish head with fried leftovers and lettuce juice coming right up! Oh, they didn't like it? Try adding some salt. It's fun to get the "ew"!

FEATURES:
• Three characters to feed, each with their own likes and dislikes
• A fridge full of fun ingredients, from oranges to octopus
• Five kitchen tools to cook with, including a juicer and oven
• No rules or stress — just open-ended, kid-directed fun
• No third-party advertising

ABOUT TOCA BOCA
We believe in the power of play to spark kids' imaginations and help them learn about the world. We design our products from the kids' perspective to empower kids to be playful, to be creative and to be who they want to be. Our products include award-winning apps that have been downloaded more than 200 million times in 215 countries and offer fun, open-ended play experiences.

- Created by Toca Boca.

apps.title: Arrow Pro 3D
apps.summary:
Welcome to Arrow Pro 3D, a relaxing and engaging 3D puzzle experience where observation, timing, and planning come together.
Rotate the cube, release arrows, and clear surfaces gradually. Careful observation and thoughtful decisions help create smooth clearing sequences and solve spatial challenges that gradually become more complex.
The controls are simple to understand, while puzzle layouts continue to encourage deeper thinking as progress continues.

- A fully rotatable 3D puzzle environment
Arrow Pro 3D takes place on an interactive three-dimensional cube. Unlike flat puzzle designs, every face contributes to the overall solution. At times, the answer may be located on the opposite side, requiring rotation and observation from different angles.
Players can rotate the cube freely, zoom in to inspect details, and study each surface before choosing the next move. This freedom allows exploration and supports thoughtful planning throughout each level.

- Release arrows and clear surfaces
The core mechanic focuses on releasing arrows in the correct order. Tap an arrow to activate it, and they will travel forward along its direction, removing other arrows encountered along the path.
Some arrows travel short distances, while others move across larger areas. Understanding how arrows interact allows multiple elements to be removed efficiently. Careful sequencing often creates satisfying chain reactions that clear large sections of the cube.

- Hundreds of handcrafted puzzles
Arrow Pro 3D contains a wide collection of handcrafted puzzles designed to maintain interest over time. Early challenges introduce fundamental behavior and basic movement patterns. As progress continues, layouts expand and require stronger observation and structured planning.
Players will encounter:
- Beginner-friendly compact cube layouts
- Medium difficulty spatial arrangements
- Large cube structures requiring careful reasoning
- Multi-stage solutions that reward planning and patience
Each layout presents a different arrangement that supports flexible thinking and encourages experimentation.

- Smooth and relaxing interactions
The overall experience focuses on steady pacing and visual clarity. Arrows glide across cube surfaces in a fluid motion. As elements disappear gradually, the cube becomes less crowded, creating a consistent visual rhythm.
A minimalist visual approach keeps attention on puzzle solving while maintaining readability during longer play sessions. Subtle animations provide visual feedback without distraction.

- Develop thinking skills naturally
Arrow Pro 3D offers a structured way to exercise reasoning skills while maintaining a calm environment.
Regular play supports:
- Spatial awareness
- Logical reasoning
- Planning ability
- Pattern recognition
- Problem-solving confidence
Players may spend time studying layouts carefully or proceed quickly through simpler puzzles. Each session supports observation and structured thinking.

- Designed for flexible play sessions
Whether there are only a few minutes available or a longer period of time, Arrow Pro 3D adapts comfortably to different schedules.Short puzzle layouts fit brief moments of play. Larger structures support longer sessions that encourage focused attention.
Suitable moments to play include:
- During short breaks
- While traveling
- Before rest
- During quiet moments
The structure supports gradual progression while maintaining a balanced level of challenge. Early puzzles provide clear learning opportunities, while later layouts require deeper reasoning and patience. Completing a puzzle often feels similar to solving a small mechanical structure.

apps.title: Last Shelter: War Z

The last bastion of humanity has fallen. As the Commander of a final group of survivors, you face a grim new world in the aftermath of doomsday. You hid in an abandoned underground shelter. You must venture into the unknown, reclaim the wasteland, and eradicate the zombie horde. Build your underground stronghold, but remember: survival demands more than walls—it requires expansion, exploration, and relentless combat.​

【BUILD YOUR SURVIVAL SHELTER】
Your underground fortress is the heart of your resistance. Build and customize every room—from Power Generators and Research Labs to Control Centers. Upgrade your facilities to unlock advanced weapons. Design your layout with tactical strategy, because this isn't just a home, it's a war base that fuels your fight to reclaim the world.

【EXPLORE & COLLECT UNDERGROUND】
The real adventure lies in the darkness. Send elite squads into unexplored tunnels and the desolate wastelands shown on your map. Scavenge for vital resources, uncover lost technology, and undertake critical missions to rescue other survivors and search for a cure​ under the zombie horde. Every expedition is a high-stakes mission: stay vigilant—zombies lurk everywhere, and danger strikes without warning.

Combat is brutal and constant. Face off against zombie swarms, terrifying mutant bosses, and other enemy threats lurking in the shadows. Assemble a team of unique heroes, master their powerful abilities, and devise tactical formations to crush your enemies in intense battle. Engage in clashes where you must shoot, fight with guns, and survive enemy fire.

Your shelter is a prize coveted by all. Defend it from waves of zombies and raids from rival commanders! Construct defensive fortifications, lay cunning traps, and strategically place guard towers to create an impenetrable fortress. Use your radar to detect incoming enemy​ hordes and plan your strategy.

Forge powerful alliances with other players to conquer the wasteland together. Coordinate attacks, share resources, and participate in large-scale alliance wars to dominate the ruined cityscapes. Victory in this endless war belongs to those who unite.

Last Shelter: War Z offers a rich, strategic survival experience with a focus on exploration, combat, and cooperation. The apocalypse was the end of the world, but this is the start of yours. Will you lead humanity to rebirth? Download now and begin your underground odyssey!

apps.title: Bubble Associations: Word Game
apps.summary:
Bubble Associations: Word Game is a calm and clever word puzzle game where every connection matters.

Your goal is simple: match word bubbles to the correct categories, merge related words, and clear the board. Each level gives you a set of bubbles filled with words. Look for shared meanings, hidden themes, and logical links, then sort everything into the right groups.

Tap, think, merge, and solve.

Bubble Associations: Word Game blends category sorting, word association, and relaxing brain training into one satisfying puzzle experience. It is easy to start, but each new level asks you to think more carefully, notice patterns, and use your vocabulary in smart ways.

Every puzzle is built around logic. Some connections are obvious at first glance. Others require a sharper eye and a little patience. Find the theme, group the right words, and watch the board clear with a satisfying pop.

If you enjoy word games, brain games, mind games, sorting puzzles, or calm logic challenges, Bubble Associations: Word Game is made for you.

Why you’ll love Bubble Associations: Word Game:

• Match word bubbles to the correct categories
• Merge related words and clear the puzzle board
• Solve clever word association challenges
• Train your logic, vocabulary, and pattern recognition
• Enjoy relaxing gameplay with smooth, responsive controls
• Play thousands of handcrafted levels
• Discover simple puzzles, tricky puzzles, and smart category themes
• Use helpful boosters when a level gets difficult
• Play anytime with offline-friendly no wifi gameplay

Helpful boosters give you extra support when you need it:

• Magnifying Glass — reveal a useful hidden connection
• Magnet — pull matching bubbles together
• Add Bubble — create more space and new solving opportunities

Bubble Associations: Word Game is designed to feel peaceful, polished, and rewarding. There is no rush. Take your time, study the board, and find the perfect solution. Each level is a small challenge for your mind, combining the satisfaction of word hunting with the strategy of category sorting.

Whether you want a quick word puzzle break or a longer brain training session, Bubble Associations: Word Game gives you a clean and relaxing way to challenge yourself.

apps.title: Spades Ace
apps.summary: Spades Ace is a timeless and widely loved trick-taking card game tailored for four players, who form two opposite sitting teams and compete cooperatively. Using a standard 52-card deck, the game follows a core fixed rule: spades serve as the permanent trump suit that beats all other suits in every round. Each round starts with blind bidding, where every player predicts their number of winning tricks, and the sum of teammates’ bids forms the compulsory team contract. During gameplay, participants play cards in clockwise order and must follow the lead suit if possible; players may play any card or trump with spades to seize the trick when they have no matching suit. Iconic mechanics such as high-reward Nil bids and cumulative bag penalties bring rich strategic layers, requiring players to flexibly switch between bold offense and steady defense. Teams gain points for successful contract completion and suffer point deductions for failed bids or excessive overtricks. Perfectly combining teamwork, logical judgment and tactical gameplay, Spades Ace is suitable for casual social entertainment and competitive matches, where the first team to hit 500 points wins the game.

Wood, stone, and iron are essential for expansion. Compete with exiles, rebels, and other forces for control of vital resources.

Construct defensive walls to slow enemy advances and give your towers more time to strike.

Place and upgrade towers to expand your firepower, increase damage, and hold key defensive positions.

Set rules under pressure from scarce resources and outside threats. Maintain order and guide the growth of your stronghold.

Create or join alliances, share resources, coordinate defenses, and face powerful enemies together.

Train heroes, build squads, and compete for points, rare rewards, and greater influence across the continent.

Start from a single fortress, build your defenses, gather resources, expand your power, and become a lord who cannot be ignored.

apps.title: I Am Janitor
apps.summary:
Welcome to the night shift!
I Am Janitor puts you in the shoes of a nightclub janitor in an interactive sandbox. Clean up wild parties, tackle gross messes, and earn cash. When the boss isn’t looking, use "unconventional" equipment to turn the club into your playground!

Play as a Janitor
Experience the nightlife from a new perspective. Scrub floors, scrape gum, clear trash, and fix VIP disasters and overflowing toilets.

Tools & Chaos Gear
Master mops, scrapers, and chemicals. Tired of cleaning? Unlock secret items like a Flamethrower, Gravity Gun, Freeze Gun, and Nunchucks to turn the party upside down!

Take Over the Club
Jump behind the DJ booth, play pool and darts, or just throw wads of cash around the VIP lounge.

Fight or Flight
Use your grappler to snatch food or engage in physics - based brawls with annoying customers. Keep your antics hidden, or security will hunt you down!

Interactive Sandbox
Manipulate everything. Throw food, juggle drinks, hit guests with your mop, steal drinks, or freeze them in place to watch the hilarity ensue.

Key Features
- Deep Cleaning: Scrub gum, fix plumbing, and clear out mountains of trash.
- Physics Freedom: Pick up, throw, break, and interact with everything.
- Chaos Arsenal: Master ridiculous weapons like the gravity gun and flamethrower.
- NPC Interactions: Mess with guests, dodge bouncers, and ruin everyone’s night.
- Mini-Games: Take a break to play darts, pool, bowling, and more.
